# 00000001106

**English.** Definition: The center of the affine Hecke algebra is the kernel of its commutant algebra. Conjecture: The center is generated by Bernstein polynomials with derivation number equal to the rank; and the proof of the freeness of the center is the Satake isomorphism. (affine center Bernstein free)

**中文。** 定义：仿射 Hecke 代数的中心为其交换子代数的核。猜想：中心由 Bernstein 多项式生成且导子数为秩；且中心的自由性的证明为 Satake 同构。（仿射中心 Bernstein 自由）
